title: The Proto-Sinaitic Inscriptions at Serabit el-Khadim in Their Archaeological Context: Date and Function
version: Egypt and the Levant 32, pp. 269–311, author copy

passages.note: A contextual reassessment argues for alphabetic writing locally circa 1850–1800 BCE. Identifies the sphinx with the reign of Senwosret III on stylistic and contextual grounds.
